notes.title: Development Updates + Special BRIndies Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, paranormal detectives![/b]

We’ve got some exciting updates about Enigma of Fear to share with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/d59548345edd414816b49c84f591edffc8a3a7bf.png[/img]

[h3][b]Enigma is coming to consoles![/b][/h3]
 Since the game’s release, we’ve been working hard on bringing Enigma of Fear to consoles! We’re currently in the testing and content adjustment phase for the new hardware. The development kits are in our hands, and things are moving full speed ahead. Soon, Mia will be able to visit The Place That Doesn’t Exist on major consoles too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/2bb9f630590d77eaecedc02ea3ae4bb79030562f.png[/img]

[h3][b]First DLC already in development![/b][/h3]
 We’re thrilled to announce that the first DLC for Enigma of Fear is already in development. Our crowdfunding backers will get some sneak peeks at screens and ideas we’re working on leading up to launch, but we’ll also be posting a few updates here for everyone!

The return to the perimeter will include a new area, lots of new puzzles, and a brand-new enigma, expanding the game’s main storyline and introducing new characters and story arcs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/d544437bab1ef7e11ea7b3d998936572148d9fd2.png[/img]

[h3][b]And to celebrate the success of Enigma of Fear...[/b][/h3]
We’re part of the very first BRIndies bundle, alongside some of Brazil’s most successful indie game hits. The bundle includes 5 amazing titles that made a splash both in Brazil and worldwide:
[list][*] Atomic Picnic
[*] Enigma do Medo
[*] Pocket Bravery
[*] Mullet Madjack
[*] Soulstone Survivors [/list]

The bundle is now available exclusively on Steam and Nuuvem for a limited time. Grab it while you can!

📅 Check out the bundle page here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53119/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53119/[/url]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*] [spoiler]Calisto[/spoiler] discovery about the Enigma of Fear is now available in the Cathedral from [spoiler]Jaser perspective[/spoiler] 
[*] Now it is possible to choose text and audio language separately 
[*] The [spoiler]Eye of the God of Fear[/spoiler] now has more details about [spoiler]its function[/spoiler] 
[*] Improvements to the pistol aiming system 
[*] Adds Lupi's rug in the Basement 
[*] Adjustment of Mia's portraits in dialogue after [spoiler] Transcending [/spoiler] 
[*] Small adjustments to evidence 
[*] Mia no longer exits stealth mode when switching items
[*] New art of Goliath and Abraham in the Strach Mansion 
[*] Small adjustments to the Mental Map 
[*] Adjustment in which the HUD in the [spoiler]Eye of the God of Fear[/spoiler] room would not appear correctly in specific resolutions 
[*] Texture optimization and memory usage 
[*] Added SteamDeck support
[/list]

Although most of the performance issues and bugs have been addressed, we will keep listening to your feedbacks and providing support. 

If you wanna get in touch with us, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/dumativa]Discord[/url].

notes.title: BUG Fix and Performance Update
notes.content:

[*] Fixed ammo boxes and medkits to respawn correctly
[*] Fixed the issue that allowed players to carry more than 3 medkits
[*] Adjustments to Samuel's Terminal
[*] Fixed bugs and made adjustments in the Mind Map
[*] Adjustment on the battle difficulty against the Cathedral boss
[*] Fixed Verity's HP and ammo bugs
[*] Adjustments to evidence, tombs, recorder and HUD
[*] Adjustments to the final cutscene so that [spoiler]Lupi[/spoiler] always appears correctly
[*] Adjustments to Mia losing important inventory items after dying
[*] Adjustments on audio in the Other Ending
[*] Added saving points after getting the [spoiler] Déjà Vu Radio [/spoiler] and when [spoiler]Transcending[/spoiler]
[/list]

Although some performance issues have been addressed, optimization work continues. For more feedback and to report bugs, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/dumativa]Discord[/url].

notes.title: BUG Fix
BUG Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed achievements that were not displaying correctly. 
[*] Added a new achievement related to the [spoiler]Cursed Puzzles [/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed the issue that caused freezing in the [spoiler]Final Sword[/spoiler]. 
[*] Fixed the Keyboard in the [spoiler]Cursed Puzzles [/spoiler] terminal. 
[*] Fixed the issue that caused the [spoiler]Samuel[/spoiler] ritual to happen before intended. 
[*] Fixed some Perimeter maps that were not behaving as they should.
[*] General Music and Sound adjustments. 
[*] Fixed the behavior of the [spoiler]Cemetery Box[/spoiler].
[*] General Visual adjustments (Evidence, UI and Portrait). 
[*] Fixed Mia's respawn at a specific point in the Cave. General pause screen fixes.
[*] Fixed general Mind Map bugs. 
[*] Fixed collisions that caused the player to leave the scene limit. 
[*] Fixed a potential softlock in the [spoiler]Jaser[/spoiler] cycle. 
[*] General fixes to the [spoiler]Goliath[/spoiler] door. 
[*] Added FPS Limit Option. 
[*] Balancing Cursed Puzzles of [spoiler]Butter on Butter[/spoiler].
[/list]

[b]There are no plans to make Lupi speak. Please stop asking.[/b]

We are aware of some performance issues causing the game to take a long time to open or experience low FPS in certain areas. We are planning to release a compatibility and optimization patch soon. 

If you have more feedbacks, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/dumativa]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Enigma of Fear is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/f46503d4fc517662194aa28c2afa42ac2d21fadb.png[/img]

[b]Hey detectives,[/b]

After a long journey, the moment is finally here.
[h1][b]Enigma of Fear is out now for everyone.[/b][/h1]

We have poured our heart and souls into this project and now it’s time for you to fully enjoy it. All the effort and dedication from Enigma of Fear’s team can be found in every detail of the narrative, art, music and, of course, in the enigmas.

A story that we’re deeply proud of, and that it’s finally waiting for you.

Play the way that you want: analyze every detail of a profound narrative, make notes, solve the puzzles, fight paranormal creatures or try to pass through them quietly.

[previewyoutube=cRqywIJpO6Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Share your experience in Enigma of Fear and use the hashtag #enigmaoffear
We also invite you to join our [url=discord.gg/dumativa]Dumativa Discord[/url] to talk with the developers and [url=discord.gg/cellbit]Cellbit’s Discord[/url] to be part of the best detective community in the world.

We will forever be grateful for all your support that led us to this moment. For making this dream come true, from the bottom of our hearts: thank you!

You are part of this story. Without you it wouldn’t exist.

Waiting for you at the Perimeter,
Dumativa & Cellbit
